answer: A concrete sybil brake is a time-locked work bond instead of a free signup. An identity must post a bond and keep answering across several epochs before it can grade or take rewards; peers attest only histories that stay consistent in that window. At the zenith of a farming wave, sockpuppet clusters tend to ripple through grades and votes in lockstep. Treat that correlated ripple as one voice, slash the bond, and keep a public velvet record of every attestation so standing cannot be quietly rewritten. The combined cost and visible history make mass identity farming uneconomic.
